payout_value_note: $75 per eligible referral; no stated referral limit
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($75-$75 per referral); time: referral share est. 5-15 min active
steps: Referrer invites friends, family, or colleagues to join PSCU. The new member provides the referring member's full name and email address within 30 days of joining and meets the qualification (direct deposit or eligible loan for 18+; direct deposit or $100 deposit for youth).
catches: Refer a Friend program open to current Public Service Credit Union (Michigan) members in good standing. Referrals must result in a new member opening a qualifying PSCU account. Referring members are subject to verification by PSCU. Members are not eligible to receive an incentive for any account in which they are considered an owner, including adding an existing member as joint owner. Reward payments may be considered taxable income; $600+ in a year is reported on IRS Form 1099-MISC. Federally insured by NCUA. PSCU reserves the right to modify or discontinue the program at any time.

eligibility: Friend: new member must identify the referring member by providing the referring member's full name and email within 30 days of joining; members 18+ must set up direct deposit or open an eligible loan; youth (0-17) must set up direct deposit or make a $100 minimum initial deposit; new member must maintain the account in good standing
timing: Credited to the referring member's primary savings account within 60 days after all eligibility requirements are met and verified.
notes: Official referral page (pscunow.com/refer, fetched 2026-09-23): 'earn $75 for each eligible referral... Refer and repeat. There's no limit to how many friends you can refer.' when_cash_arrives: Credited to the referring member's primary savings account within 60 days after all eligibility requirements are met and verified. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
